apps.name: Dream Eater: Dream Interpreter
apps.description:
You wake at 3 a.m. with a dream still vivid. Say it out loud or type it, and Dream Eater keeps it safe, with the real moon and sky of that night beside it.

THE JOURNAL IS FREE, FOREVER
Voice capture that works offline and turns your words into text on your iPhone. Drafts that survive a crash. A calendar, search, tags, favorites, export. No account, no sign-up, nothing standing between you and the half-remembered.

A READING IN YOUR OWN WORDS
Ask for a reading and get a reflection, not a verdict. It quotes your dream back to you, asks open questions, and names the tradition when one reads an image a certain way (Jungian, Gestalt, folk). It never claims a symbol has one fixed meaning, and it never claims to know what will happen.

THE MOON AND THE SKY
Every dream is stamped with the moon phase and the Moon's sign from that night, computed on your iPhone. Add your birth details if you like, and see your chart and what is passing through it. Astrology here is a reflective lens, not evidence about your life, and it is optional.

PATTERNS THAT ARE TRUE
See your streak, your tones and feelings, the themes that keep coming back, and when you dream. If you ask whether the moon matters, the app tells you honestly how many nights it takes to say anything, and shows what chance alone would give you.

ART MADE FROM YOUR DREAM
Turn a dream into a picture in one of six styles, from soft dreamscape to ink wash to collage. Save it, or share a card with the dream's title and the moon.

BUILT FOR THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT
A Record button on the Lock Screen and in Control Center, a moon widget, a Bedside theme that keeps the light low. Large text, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion are supported throughout.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your dreams, recordings, transcripts, tags and birth details stay on your device. When you ask for a reading, the dream text goes to our server and on to Google's Gemini model to write it, and our server keeps no dream text afterward. You choose whether readings are on, and you can delete everything from Settings.

FREE, PLUS, OR PAY AS YOU GO
Three readings a week are free. Plus unlocks unlimited readings, dream art in six styles, follow-up questions and your sky. Start with a 7-day free trial on the annual plan, or skip subscriptions and buy credits that never expire.

Dream Eater is for reflection and entertainment. It is not medical, psychological or therapeutic advice. If you are struggling, support is one tap away in Settings, Help, Crisis resources.

Available in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

Plus is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or annual, with a 7-day free trial on the annual plan for new subscribers. The price is shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation, and the subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings, Apple Account, Subscriptions. A lifetime purchase is also available.

apps.name: Psywave: AI Playlist Maker

Turn any photo or mood into a real playlist in seconds — then play it in Apple Music with one tap.

Psywave is an AI playlist maker for people who hear a moment before they can name it. Pick a photo — a sunset drive, a rainy window, a party — or type a vibe like "neon city at 2 a.m." or "Sunday coffee, slow and warm", and Psywave builds a playlist of real songs that fit.

PHOTOS BECOME PLAYLISTS
Psywave reads the light, colors and mood of your picture and scores it with real tracks. Share a photo to Psywave straight from the Photos app, or ask Siri: "Make a playlist in Psywave."

FAMILIAR HITS OR DEEP CUTS
Choose how adventurous each playlist is: crowd-pleasers, a mix, or the underrated album tracks you haven't heard yet. Playlists include artists from your own country when they fit, and come back titled in your language.

ONE TAP INTO APPLE MUSIC
Every song is matched to the Apple Music catalog, so what you see is what plays. Preview any track, remove what you don't like, add ten more, then import the whole playlist.

SHARE THE VIBE
Share a link anyone can open: every song links to Apple Music, with search links for whatever app your friends use. Each playlist also gets a story-ready card with a scannable code. Using another service? Export a track list you can import there.

PSYWAVE PRO
• Unlimited playlists
• Longer playlists, up to 50 songs
• Only songs new to you: skip what's already in your library
• Grow any of your own Apple Music playlists with songs that fit

LEARN THROUGH PLAY
Every lesson is a few minutes. Multiple-choice, matching and true-or-false questions give immediate feedback, so the ideas actually stick. Mastery tests crown each path and your streak keeps you coming back.

EVERY BELIEF, SIDE BY SIDE
Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Buddhism, Hinduism, Norse, Egyptian, Greek, Zoroastrian and many more, each with its own theme and voice. See where traditions agree, where they diverge, and what they each say lies beyond, all in one place.

START FREE

GO PREMIUM
Unlock all 21 remaining paths, unlimited Oracle conversations and every future path with Premium. Try it free for 7 days, then keep learning for one annual price, or go monthly. Prefer to own forever? Unlock a single path on its own, or take Ultimate lifetime access.

BUILT TO KEEP YOU LEARNING

Hold your button and speak; Psybeam says it out loud in their language. Hold their button while they answer, and you hear them in yours. The translation always faces whoever it's for, so the person across from you understands instantly — no app for them, no typing, no learning the UI.

Real-time voice-to-voice, built for travel. Order food, ask directions, sort out a hostel, talk to a pharmacist or a taxi driver — face to face, in seconds.

WHY PSYBEAM
— No account, no sign-up. It opens straight to talking; sign in with Apple later only if you want to sync.
— No subscription, no trial trap. Pay only for the minutes you actually talk. Start with free minutes, then buy a pack when you need more — never a recurring charge.
— Your conversation stays on your device.

HOW IT WORKS
— Two thumb buttons: your language and theirs. Hold to speak, release to send.
— Natural speech-to-speech that follows the speaker's own voice.
— 22 languages, spoken aloud both ways.
— Cross a border? Psybeam auto-suggests the local language from your location.
— One phone, one operator — the other person just listens, then speaks when it's their turn.

BUILT FOR
Travelers, markets, hotel and hostel desks, taxis, pharmacies, asking a local for help — any moment you and someone else don't share a language.

iPhone, iOS 18 and later. Open it, hold a button, and have your first cross-language conversation in seconds.

apps.name: Pay Day: E-Invoice & Peppol
apps.description:
Most invoice apps make a pretty PDF. Pay Day makes one your tax authority's system can actually read.

The EU is switching to mandatory electronic invoicing. Belgium requires every VAT-registered business to send and receive structured e-invoices over Peppol since 1 January 2026, with fines for a plain PDF. France went live on 1 September 2026, and small businesses must issue e-invoices from 1 September 2027. Germany follows in 2027 and 2028, and EU-wide cross-border e-invoicing arrives in 2030. A normal PDF is no longer enough. Pay Day is built for exactly this moment, on your iPhone, with no desktop software and no monthly bookkeeping suite.

FREE, AND GENUINELY GENEROUS
- Unlimited invoices and estimates. No per-document limit, no watermark, no "upgrade to export."
- Unlimited clients, your logo, and multi-currency with European Central Bank reference rates.
- A real EN 16931 VAT engine: standard rates, intra-community reverse charge, zero-rated and exempt lines — with a correct, properly rounded VAT breakdown on every document.
- Works fully offline. Bill from a job site, a train, anywhere.
- No account required to start. Open the app and you're invoicing.
- Your country's e-invoicing rules on the dashboard: what is mandatory, since when, and what to set up.
- Live VAT validation: check every client's VAT ID against the EU VIES service before you issue.

PRO — REAL E-INVOICE COMPLIANCE, NOT JUST A PDF
- Factur-X / ZUGFeRD e-invoices: a single hybrid file that looks like a clean invoice to your client and carries embedded EN 16931 data a tax authority's system can read automatically. Independently validated as a valid PDF/A-3 with valid EN 16931 XML.
- Peppol delivery: send your invoice straight into your client's accounting system over the EU's official network — no email attachment, no portal logins.

CREDIT PACKS — PAY ONLY FOR WHAT YOU SEND
- Top up with consumable credit packs that cover each Peppol network send (we pass through the real per-send cost rather than padding a subscription).
- The same credits power optional AI helpers: snap a photo of a quote or receipt and turn it into line items, or type a rough description and let it draft the lines. AI actions cost a few credits each and are entirely optional — the app is complete without them.

WHO IT'S FOR
Freelancers, consultants, designers, developers, and small businesses across the EU who invoice other businesses and need to be ready for e-invoicing mandates — without paying for a heavyweight accounting platform.

HONEST PROMISE
The free app is a complete invoicing tool, not a trial. We only ask you to pay where it genuinely costs us or genuinely earns you compliance: structured e-invoices, network delivery, and AI. No fake urgency, no nagging, no surprise limits.

Pay Day Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or annual with a 7-day free trial. Peppol network sends are metered separately via consumable credit packs on every Pro plan. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings. Credit packs are one-time purchases.

apps.name: Helia: UV Index & Sun Safety
apps.description:
Helia is the honest solar coach. Most sun apps either push you to maximize a tan or just show a raw UV number. Helia does neither. It treats sunlight like what it is — something to enjoy on a budget. The sunburn is the enemy, not the sun.

Helia reads today's UV conditions for your exact location and your skin, then gives you one clear answer: roughly how long you can be in the sun before you should cover up, reapply, or head for shade. That answer — your sunburn budget — is free, forever. We never put safety behind a paywall.

THE FREE SAFETY CORE — for everyone
• Hands-free tracking. Helia can notice when you head out into daylight, meter the session itself, and log it — no timers to start or stop.
• Your sunburn budget. A personalized estimate of how long today's sun may take before your skin has had enough, based on the live UV index and your skin type.
• The Answer. One glance tells you whether it's a cover-up day, a quick-session day, or a stay-out day — no decoding color charts.
• Live UV index + forecast. See the UV climb and fall through the day so you can plan around the harshest hours.
• Cloud- and rain-aware. Helia corrects the UV for the real sky, so an overcast day reads honestly — not as full sun.
• Reapply & cover-up nudges. Gentle reminders to top up sunscreen or step into shade before you've used up your budget.
• Honest by design. Helia rounds toward caution. When in doubt, it tells you to protect.

PRO — the coaching layer (optional)
Pro turns Helia from an instrument into a coach, with guidance grounded in how sunlight affects the body across the day:
• Morning-light timing. Helia suggests when a little outdoor light may help support your daily rhythm and energy — the circadian side of sunlight.
• Your vitamin-D plan. A 12-month, season-aware calendar of what sunlight can realistically contribute at your latitude — including the honest winter months when it can't. The live estimate on Home stays free.
• The Sun Atlas. Every session and every walked Sun Trail on one map — your sun, over time.
• On-device science coach. Ask anything about sun, UV, vitamin D, and your body clock — answered privately on your phone, grounded in cited sources, never the cloud.
• History & trends. Your sun, your budget used, and your patterns over weeks and seasons.

WHY PEOPLE KEEP HELIA INSTALLED
Helia isn't trying to get you a deeper tan or sell you fear. It's a quiet, trustworthy instrument that earns its home-screen spot.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Helia works for you, not on you. Your sun sessions, skin type, and location stay on your device wherever possible and are used to personalize your estimates — not to profile you. Precise location is used only to read your local sun and UV conditions. The coach runs entirely on your device.

A NOTE ON HEALTH
Helia provides general wellness estimates and guidance, not medical advice. Sunburn-budget and vitamin-D figures are estimates based on public UV data and the details you provide — they may differ from reality. Helia does not diagnose, treat, or prevent any condition. For anything concerning your skin or health, please consult a qualified clinician.

Get the free sunburn budget today. Upgrade to Pro when you want the coaching.

apps.description:
Crucible is a native client for your Plex Media Server on iPhone and Apple TV. It is built to feel like part of the system: the system player, native menus and context menus, Liquid Glass on the newest software, and a library that opens exactly where you left off.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Home opens on a Resume hero, then Continue Watching, Up Next and Recently Added. Library grids have filters for Unwatched and In Progress, genre and sort, an A–Z scrubber and folder browsing for unindexed content. Search groups results by type with a Top Result.

A PLAYER THAT RESPECTS YOUR TIME
Skip Intro and Skip Credits from Plex markers, audio and subtitle menus, adjustable speed, lock screen controls and Up Next that rolls the next episode as the credits start. On iPhone: Picture-in-Picture and background audio. Direct play when your device can handle the file, automatic transcoding when it can't.

MADE FOR THE COUCH
The Apple TV app is built for the Siri Remote: a cinematic Home that follows focus, one tab per library, native context menus, search, and Top Shelf with Continue Watching and Up Next. Liquid Glass on tvOS 26.

TAKE IT OFFLINE
On iPhone, download movies, seasons or single episodes in the quality you pick. Transfers continue in the background, stay on Wi-Fi by default and show a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Offline playback uses the same player.

KNOW YOUR VIEWING
Watch History grouped by day, Statistics with streaks, heatmaps, binges and taste built from your own Plex history, and a Year in Review poster you can share.

FREE TO USE, CRUCIBLE PRO TO GO FURTHER
Browsing, search and playback are free on iPhone and Apple TV, and so is the Statistics view for the last week. Crucible Pro unlocks unlimited offline downloads, the full Statistics screen with every range and library filter, the Year in Review poster and Top Shelf. Pay once for lifetime access, or subscribe yearly with a 14-day free trial. One purchase covers iPhone and Apple TV, and Family Sharing is on.

TRY IT WITHOUT A SERVER
No Plex server yet? Choose Try the demo on the welcome screen to explore a fictional library with everything unlocked, guided by a short tour.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account with us, no ads, no analytics. Crucible talks only to plex.tv and the server you choose.

OPEN SOURCE
Crucible is free software under GPL-3.0: https://github.com/guitaripod/Crucible

Crucible needs a Plex Media Server. Plex requires a Plex Pass or Remote Watch Pass to stream from your server away from home. Crucible is an independent app and is not made by, endorsed by or affiliated with Plex, Inc. Plex is a trademark of Plex, Inc.

apps.name: Tailscode: Coding Agent Remote
apps.description:
Send a prompt to Claude Code, opencode or Oh My Pi from your phone, pocket it, and watch the turn finish on your Lock Screen. Approve the risky command, answer the agent's question, read the diff — over your own Tailscale network, with no relay, no account and no analytics. Free and open source.

TRY IT BEFORE YOU WIRE ANYTHING
A built-in demo walks every screen with sample conversations. No server needed.

WHAT YOU NEED
A Mac or Linux machine on your tailnet (Tailscale is free for personal use) running one of your agents: opencode, Claude Code through the open-source claude-bridge, or Oh My Pi through the open-source omp-bridge. Set-up is three verified steps.

THE TURN, LIVE ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
• A Live Activity per conversation: what it is doing, for how long, and how many tools it has run.
• An approval request alerts you; a finished turn lingers with its outcome. Tap to land in the exact chat.
• Updates arrive by push while the app is suspended.

A NATIVE TRANSCRIPT, NOT A TERMINAL
• Streaming text written at the model's own speed, with thinking and tool runs folded into readable groups.
• Diffs, commands and their real output inline; syntax-highlighted code with byte-exact copy.
• Allow once, always, or deny without leaving the chat. Agent questions become tappable cards, and a failed turn says what happened and offers to try again.
• One quiet row of facts — context, spend, branch, agents out — that steps aside when there is nothing to say.
• Queue the next message while a turn runs, edit it before it goes, or stop the turn on the server.
• Every picture the agent hands you, in a gallery you can zoom, save or share.

EVERY MACHINE ON ONE BOARD
• All your servers' conversations in one list, live status first, grouped by project.
• Read the repository before you trust the change: branch, staged, changed, untracked, and the diff of any file.
• Subagents dock inside the turn that spawned them; a compaction is drawn as a seam with what it kept.
• Slash commands from the server's own catalog, per-message model and reasoning effort, forking.

KNOW WHAT IT COSTS
• Every conversation priced, every month totalled across machines — by model, project and tool.
• Plan limits and quotas for Claude, Grok, Ollama Cloud, DeepSeek and more, on Home and in a widget.

PICTURES AND CLIPS, ON YOUR OWN MACHINE
• Describe an image or a short clip in words; it renders on your own machine and arrives in the app.

HAND OFF THE ROUTINE WORK (BETA)
• A cheaper model tries first and a verifier decides. Nothing lands until it passes.

YOURS, END TO END
• Point-to-point over your tailnet. No relay servers, no account, no analytics, nobody reading your code.
• Programmatic UIKit, Swift 6, Liquid Glass on iOS 26. Eight themes, dark mode, Dynamic Type, haptics.
• Open source under GPL-3.0 — the app, the engine, and both bridges.

FREE, WITH AN HONEST PRO
The free app is the complete core: one server, full chat, approvals, attachments, models, forking, and Live Activities. Tailscode Pro is a one-time purchase, no subscription: multiple saved servers, concurrent Live Activities, the delegate board, and a supporter badge.

Tailscode is independent open-source software: not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, Tailscale Inc., the opencode project or Oh My Pi.

Privacy policy: https://midgarcorp.cc/tailscode/privacy
Source code: https://github.com/guitaripod/Tailscode
